landscape.label: Rules to Know
landscape.title: Pacific Palisades ADU rules to know

tiles.s: Junior ADUs stay inside the house
No Coastal or CEQA review for many rebuild ADUs

landscape.speak: A few rules to know. A city has sixty days to act on a complete application. A junior ADU tops out at five hundred square feet. ADUs of seven hundred fifty square feet or less skip impact fees. And on fire-damaged lots, the Mayor's executive order lets many rebuild ADUs skip Coastal and CEQA review.
landscape.say: A few rules to know. A city has 60 days to act on a complete application. A junior ADU tops out at 500 square feet. ADUs of 750 square feet or less skip impact fees. And on fire-damaged lots, the Mayor's executive order lets many rebuild ADUs skip Coastal and CEQA review.

landscape.say: What drives the price in Pacific Palisades? Fire rebuild timing: build the ADU with or before the new home. Bluffs & hillsides: deeper foundations & setbacks from the edge. Narrow streets: staging, deliveries & haul trips. Fire-zone materials: ignition-resistant construction. LADWP service: a separate meter means a bigger panel. HOA guidelines: many Palisades HOAs regulate design.
